description.value: The Bulkley Valley Museum preserves and presents the history and heritage of the Bulkley Valley region of northwestern British Columbia, including Indigenous, settler, and industrial history. It occupies a public building on Main Street in Smithers, a key stop on the Yellowhead Highway (Hwy 16) corridor — a major cross-Canada touring route. Cyclists riding this remote stretch will find it a meaningful cultural pause in an area where heritage sites are sparse.
